thread:
Noah (Support): P1 alert for trial customer acerohealth.dev — embeddings failing across 3 tenant namespaces, onboarding stalled. Error rate ~60% over last 25m. @Asha can CS lead comms and bridge?
Asha (CS): On it. Need quick mitigation + ETA. I'll draft proactive note and schedule 15m bridge.
Noah (Support): Symptoms: 502s from inference-gateway to redwood-embed-5-large and sporadic 401 token errors. Restarted gateway, flushed prefix cache, attempted model failover — still failing. Sample log: `ERROR inference-gateway: upstream returned 502 for model redwood-embed-5-large trace=9f2b`
OpsBot: [alert] customer=acerohealth.dev incidents=INC-9012 severity=high
Ravi (SRE): Likely overloaded embed pool + token rotation edge-case. Plan: scale standby pool and try routing affected tenants to standby. Cmds: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-pool-standby --replicas=2` then `rwctl route update --tenant acerohealth --model standby-embed-1 --weight 1.0`
Noah (Support): Tried route to quantized-embed-4 earlier; gateway rejected due to model-compatibility. Also seeing `{"error":"token_mismatch","code":401}` for two tenant namespaces.
Asha (CS): Draft comms (short):
"Hi <Name>, we detected an issue affecting embedding during your trial. We're applying an interim routing fix and investigating token mismatches. Expect stability within 60 minutes; scheduling a follow-up to review root cause and extend trial/credit for the disruption.  Asha, CS"
Jules (Acct Exec): Approve a small trial extension + goodwill credit. I'll coordinate post-incident messaging after CS initial note.
Ravi (SRE): Standby pool scaled, routing change applied for subset — one tenant now 95% success. Two tenants still failing on auth; SSO/token team investigating. Temporary workaround: re-issue tenant tokens via admin console; test curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` returns 200 for test vectors.
Noah (Support): I'll run re-issue for affected tenants and confirm. If tokens don't fix within 30m, escalate to eng-runtime.
Asha (CS): Owners: support/Noah (remediation), SRE/Ravi (infra), CS/Asha & Jules (comms + credits). Reconvene in 45m to verify full recovery. OpsBot attach INC-9012 to thread please.
